tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Never put text directly on a photo; put it on bg or surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list rows, text fields. The default reading surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers: dialogs, bottom sheets, menus, toasts (pair with an elevation shadow in light).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Grouped-list background, segmented-control track, skeleton base.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the only cue for an interactive boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (text fields, checkboxes, unselected chips). Meets 3:1 against surface and bg in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: supporting lines, helper text, timestamps, placeholder. 4.5:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons of disabled controls only (exempt from contrast rules). Never for content people need to read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand action colour: primary buttons, selected tab, switch on, checkbox checked, links. Text in primary is legible on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed/active state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill: selected chip, selected list row, info-neutral highlights.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand accent for highlights and illustration — badges for 'new', rating stars, progress celebration. Never a button fill for the main action.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error text/icons. Legible on surface and bg.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and error field background.

tokens.name: on-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icons and text. Always paired with an icon or word — never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner background.

tokens.name: on-success-soft
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons and text (darkened amber so it reads as text).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner background.

tokens.name: on-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Text on warning-soft.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational icons and text.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner background.

tokens.name: on-info-soft
tokens.usage: Text on info-soft.

tokens.name: brand-surface
tokens.usage: The branded header band on Home (and splash/sign-in). Same deep teal in both themes so the brand reads at a glance.

tokens.name: on-brand-surface
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-surface (≥ 9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: on-brand-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on brand-surface: dates, sync status (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / switch-access focus ring: 2px, offset 2px. Distinct from primary so focus is never confused with selection.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and bottom sheets. Tapping it dismisses non-critical layers.

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero numbers and onboarding headlines. Max one per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Large screen title (collapsing top bar, expanded state).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section headers inside a screen; dialog titles.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, bottom-sheet titles, compact top bar title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text. Never below 16px for paragraphs — it also prevents iOS zoom-on-focus in inputs.
styles.sample: Your order is on its way and should arrive by 6 pm.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; list-row primary line.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Dense secondary content: list-row supporting line, banner text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button and chip labels, tab-bar labels at large size. Sentence case.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Helper and error text under fields, timestamps, legal notes.
styles.sample: We'll only use this to send receipts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions and chart axes only. Smallest allowed size.

spacing.note: 4-point grid. Every margin, padding and gap is one of these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tightly related items (icon + text, stacked label + value).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list-row elements; chip row gap; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin (gutter) on phones; card padding; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on large phones (≥ 428pt) and tablets in compact layouts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups within a section; sheet and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state and onboarding vertical breathing room.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding above a large title; space above a sticky primary action.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing only.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, progress bars, focus-ring corners on small items.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented-control segments, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, list groups, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches, icon buttons, pill chips.

shadow.note: Elevation is shown by shadow in light and by a lighter surface (surface-raised) in dark; dark shadows are kept faint.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on bg; raised tab bar.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus, floating buttons.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets over a scrim.

size.note: Fitts's law in tokens: anything tappable is at least size-touch, whatever its drawn size.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every tappable element (Material 48dp; exceeds Apple 44pt and WCAG 2.5.8).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, text fields, list rows (single line).

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the primary bottom action and two-line list rows.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and footnotes.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size (toolbars, list rows, tab bar).

tokens.name: size-avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars in dense lists and chips.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Avatars in list rows.

tokens.name: size-avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Profile headers.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Compact top bar height (below the status-bar safe area).

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height (above the home-indicator safe area).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (whole control).

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed-state overlay on non-filled controls (ink at this opacity).

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pointer overlay on tablets with trackpads.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Screen content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers, top bar, tab bar.

tokens.name: z-fab
tokens.usage: Floating action button.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts — always above everything so feedback is never hidden.
